propositions: Four review-interrupt firings on 2026-08-12 exceeded the DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX bound of 1800s by 10–130s (observed deferred_for: 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s), killing in-flight LLM reviews and stalling the gate
The deferral bound was sized at 1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (1200s) for steady-state review queues and is marginally too small during merge landing bursts
Raising DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX from 1800s to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) absorbs the observed overshoots by a 470s margin and prevents all four Aug-12 firings
The pinned test relationship must be tightened from >= 1.0x to >= 2.0x DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to enforce the new bound and self-adjust if REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes
A saturated episode (where in_flight oscillates without reaching zero) is not fixed by a larger bound and remains a residual defect requiring a separate drain signal
